origin.description: Attach a handler to the frame that called this one.
origin.details: The inner handler runs when the inner scope exits. The parent handler runs when the outer scope exits.

translation.description: Attach a handler to the frame that called this one.
translation.details: The inner handler runs when the inner scope exits. The parent handler runs when the outer scope exits.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

bucket = []
with scope():
    with scope():
        defer_parent(lambda: bucket.append("p"))
        defer(lambda: bucket.append("i"))
    bucket.append("mid")
return bucket
